OUT=/work/report.md
FILES=$(find /work/logs -type f -newermt "24 hours ago")
if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then
  printf "# Log report\n\nNo log files modified in the last 24 hours were found in /work/logs.\n" >"$OUT"
  echo "Report written to $OUT"
  exit 0
fi
# collect error lines
ERROR_RE="error|fail|exception|critical|fatal|warn|traceback|panic|segfault|500|502|503|504"
# extract lines
MAPFILE -t LINES < <(grep -iE --binary-files=text -h "$ERROR_RE" $FILES || true)
TOTAL_ERRORS=${#LINES[@]}
# counts by category
count_cat(){ grep -iE -h "$1" $FILES | wc -l; }
ERR_ERROR=$(count_cat "error")
ERR_WARN=$(count_cat "warn")
ERR_EXCEPTION=$(count_cat "exception|traceback")
ERR_FAIL=$(count_cat "fail|failed")
ERR_CRIT=$(count_cat "critical|fatal|panic|segfault")
ERR_HTTP=$(grep -hEo --binary-files=text "HTTP/[0-9.]+\" [45][0-9][0-9]" $FILES | wc -l || true)
# top distinct messages: normalize lines by removing timestamps and file prefixes
TOP_MESSAGES=$(printf "%s\n" "${LINES[@]}" | sed -E "s/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[ Tt]?[0-9:,.+-]*//; s/^[A-Z][a-z]{2} [ 0-9]{1,2} [0-9:]{8}//; s/^[^:]*: //; " | sed -E "s/([0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}).*//" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 20)
# timing: extract hour buckets
printf "%s\n" "${LINES[@]}" | sed -E -n "s/^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})[ T]?([0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2}):.*/\1 \2/p; s/^([A-Z][a-z]{2}) +([ 0-9]{1,2}) ([0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2}):.*/\1 \2 \3/p" | awk '{counts[$0]++} END {for (k in counts) print counts[k], k}' | sort -rn > /tmp/hourly_counts.txt || true
# write report
{
  echo "# Log report"
  echo ""
  echo "Generated: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
  echo ""
  echo "Scope: files under /work/logs modified in the last 24 hours"
  echo ""
  echo "Summary of error-like lines: total matches = $TOTAL_ERRORS"
  echo ""
  echo "Estimated category frequencies (approximate):"
  printf " - ERROR: %s\n" "$ERR_ERROR"
  printf " - WARN: %s\n" "$ERR_WARN"
  printf " - EXCEPTION/TRACEBACK: %s\n" "$ERR_EXCEPTION"
  printf " - FAIL/FAILED: %s\n" "$ERR_FAIL"
  printf " - CRITICAL/FATAL/PANIC: %s\n" "$ERR_CRIT"
  printf " - HTTP 5xx (direct matches): %s\n" "$ERR_HTTP"
  echo ""
  echo "Top distinct error messages (up to 20):"
  if [ -z "$TOP_MESSAGES" ]; then
    echo " (no matching error lines to show)"
  else
    echo "$TOP_MESSAGES"
  fi
  echo ""
  echo "Timing pattern (approx hour buckets):"
  if [ -s /tmp/hourly_counts.txt ]; then
    cat /tmp/hourly_counts.txt
  else
    echo " (no timestamped error lines or unable to parse timestamps)"
  fi
  echo ""
  echo "Files scanned:"
  for f in $FILES; do echo " - $f"; done
} >"$OUT"
echo "Report written to $OUT"
'
